issues.on_page: General Government line 29: General 84,465.47, Street 21,954.04, Cemetery 12,930.67, Fire 6,206.80, Keno 13,383.00
issues.issue: Every fund's spending is printed on the General Government line. Street, Cemetery and Fire fund spending is probably streets/highways, health/welfare and public safety. Recording it as printed is defensible, but the function split is misleading.

issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other, Keno Fund column 34,885.87
issues.issue: The category comes from the fund name, not the line label (already marked review).

issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other: General 8,956.52, Street 178.70, Cemetery 3,561.30, Fire 36.10, Rev. Sharing 4.50
issues.issue: Several fund columns are combined into one 'other' line. The Cemetery 3,561.30 is probably cemetery fees, but the page doesn't break it down.
Enterprise-fund 'Other' receipts are presumed to be utility charges. The p6 transfer schedule calls this fund 'Water'.
The schedule lists a transfer from the Cemetery fund to itself. It shows as both a transfer in and a transfer out, so it nets to zero, but it inflates gross transfers and looks like a preparer error.
